reports.title: Roberto Bottello: Prevention of future deaths report

promises.quote: Concern number 6 - Psychiatric liaison nurses and psychiatric liaison doctors should have regard to diagnoses made by other doctors
promises.summary: Require psychiatric liaison staff to consider diagnoses from other doctors

concerns.quote: CNWL failed in its duty of candour in relation to provision of evidence
SPA call handlers were not sufficiently trained in how to identify patients by using computer searches and by not seeking information appropriately
police officers may need reminding to use the phonetic alphabet and using the word for the month in a person's date of birth

psychiatric liaison nurses and psychiatric liaison doctors should have regard to and specifically consider diagnoses made by other doctors for example those who see such patients repeatedly in A&E as in this case
most section 136 usage is out of hours when there is less resource to respond from psychiatric services
use of film over glass in areas where patients are at increased risk of smashing windows should be more widespread in the NHSE estate
concerns.hazard: inadequate window safety in high‑risk areas

reports.title: Declan Morrison: Prevention of Future Deaths Report
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: widespread shortage of available placements for someone with Declan's complex needs both in the community and within the NHS

links.explanation: Both reports highlight that the Section 136 suite is inadequate—either due to limited out‑of‑hours resources or being wholly unsuitable for patients in crisis.
links.earlier_quote: That most section 136 usage is out of hours when there is less resource to respond from psychiatric services.
links.later_quote: The Section 136 Suite was completely inappropriate. Declan's mental health and behaviour declined further and ultimately this resulted in his death.
